<!-- Generated by `bun run docs:reference` from seek's definitions. Do not edit. -->

Run a seek back-end that holds provider API keys and proxies CLI calls to providers.

Part of [`seek`](seek.md).

## Usage

```text
seek serve [options]
```

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-h, --help` | display help for command |  |

## Configuration options

These flags set the configuration this command reads; the [configuration reference](../configuration.md) describes each setting.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--config <path>` | Read this configuration file in place of the default files (env: SEEK_CONFIG) |
| `--server-host <host>` | Set server.host (env: SEEK_SERVER_HOST) |
| `--host <host>` | Alias of --server-host |
| `--server-port <number>` | Set server.port (env: SEEK_SERVER_PORT) |
| `--port <number>` | Alias of --server-port |
| `--server-require-token` | Set server.require-token (env: SEEK_SERVER_REQUIRE_TOKEN) |

## Exit statuses

`seek serve` exits with one of the [exit statuses of `seek`](seek.md#exit-statuses).
